newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai commerce minister tenders resignation.
newsitem.headline: Thai commerce minister tenders resignation.

text.p: Thai Commerce Minister Narongchai Akrasanee on Thursday said he had tendered his resignation to the prime minister to be effective from June 21.
He had earlier in the day told reporters he would quit over the weekend and that he had yet to submit his resignation letter to Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh.
Narongchai said the move was to give Chavalit room to reshuffle his economic team.
The unelected minister was chosen by former Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan -- who also resigned -- to help salvage the ailing Thai economy which is now at its worst in over a decade.
"If minister Amnuay resigned, I would also have to show professional spirit," he told reporters.
"I am politically naive and dumb...The premier did not stop me...but he did say he didn't want us to leave," Narongchai said.
